scope: CPU MD ownership refactor; LJ only same-input LAMMPS performance acceptance

environment.compiler:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin
environment.mpi:
mpiexec (Open MPI) 5.0.9

Report bugs to https://www.open-mpi.org/community/help/

build: Release AppleClang 21, -O3 -march=native; OpenMPI 5.0.9, Homebrew libomp; double precision
lammps_style: ordinary lj/cut for one thread, lj/cut/omp for multiple threads
order: ATV then LAMMPS sequentially; no task build/test/other benchmark overlap

model.tallies: force, energy and all six virial components each step

limitations: Shared Apple M4 desktop, ordinary system applications remain active. All samples retained; this is not a guarantee for x86, clusters or other potentials.
Performance matrix uses orthorhombic LJ; tilted, small-box multiple-image and nested cases are correctness checks.
Initial and one-step energy/force checks do not establish long-trajectory or pressure-value equivalence. Integration unit constants differ by about 1e-7 relative.
No final before/after paired timing claim; earlier pilot measurements are not used as the baseline.

reproduction.lammps: mpiexec -n RANKS <lmp> -in benchmarks/lj/in.cpu -var PREFIX PREFIX -var WARM 20 -var STEPS 200 -log PREFIX.lmp.log -screen none; append -sf omp -pk omp THREADS only for THREADS > 1
